hook.name: UniHooks Shared Hook
hook.description: Configurable shared Uniswap v4 launch hook where pool creators set immutable per-pool rules at initialization (anti-snipe, burn, LP rewards, treasury fee, sell tax, trading start, allowlist, wallet cap, same-block guard, liquidity lock, exit decay, volatility fee, sandwich guard). Collects a 0.10% platform fee on every swap in the paired token; reverts on exact-output swaps.
